acceptance: Each listed query is fixed with executed sqlite3 results matching DuckDB, or registered as an explicit SQLite skip with a reason, with owner decisions recorded where benchmark text changes.
The ROLLUP gap for TPC-DS Q5/Q77/Q80 is classified the same way.
description: Found by the SQLite rerun (report ~/Developer/benchmark_runs/sqlite-day-offset-rerun-20261021/REPORT.md). Havoc 1_v7 uses a DuckDB LIST aggregate (near '[0]') and 1_v9 uses GROUPING SETS (near 'SETS'); both fail identically on old and new wheels and are not the known ROLLUP gap. tpcds_obt Q16, Q94 and Q95 use the unpadded date literal '1999-5-01', which SQLite compares as text so results differ from DuckDB on both wheels. Decide per query: a fork lowering (GROUPING SETS/ROLLUP expansion to UNION ALL, list aggregate lowering), a documented SQLite skip with reason, or fixing the benchmark text (benchmark definition, owner decision). The most-correct-result rule applies; each must end with an executed result matching DuckDB or a registered skip.
